name: local-real-model
description: A small isolated acceptance suite for a configured real coding model.

cases.name: explain-project
cases.description: Read a tiny project and explain it without modifying files.
cases.prompt: Read README.md and the smallest relevant source file. Explain what this project does and how calculate_total handles an empty list. Do not modify any file.

files.README.md:
# Sample Totals

A tiny Python package that calculates order totals.
files.src/totals.py:
def calculate_total(values: list[int]) -> int:
    return sum(values)

cases.name: inspect-implementation
cases.description: Locate an implementation and explain a concrete edge case.
cases.prompt: Locate the divide function in this workspace and explain exactly what currently happens when divisor is zero. Cite the relevant file path in your answer. Do not modify files.

cases.name: small-verified-edit
cases.description: Make one bounded code change and verify it.
cases.prompt: Update divide in src/calculator.py so divisor zero raises ValueError with a clear message. Add a focused pytest test, inspect the resulting Git diff, and run the narrowest relevant test command. Keep the change minimal.

cases.name: missing-file-recovery
cases.description: Handle an absent file without fabricating or creating it.
cases.prompt: Find config/production-secrets.yaml. If it does not exist, say so clearly, briefly describe how you checked, and stop. Do not create or modify any file.

files.README.md:
# Missing File Fixture

This fixture intentionally has no config directory.

cases.name: approval-lifecycle
cases.description: Exercise a write approval and resume the same durable Run.
cases.prompt: Create RESULT.txt containing exactly: acceptance lifecycle completed. Then inspect the Git diff and summarize the change. Do not modify any other file.
